tasks.spec:
You are fixing a missing auth header in a probe harness in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/boarding_probe.py and tests/test_boarding_probe.py. Never edit storygame/, data/, docs/, .plans/. Never make a live call.

DEFECT: a live smoke got HTTP 401 on all 8 calls because `_send_narrator` in boarding_probe.py builds its Request headers without the Authorization header. The product provider (storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py around line 2104) adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when its token is non-empty, where the token comes from the CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN environment variable (stripped; line 327). FIX: in `_send_narrator`, read os.environ CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN (stripped) and add the same Authorization header only when non-empty. Never write the token into any output file, row, log or exception text.

TEST FIRST in tests/test_boarding_probe.py: with a fake opener capturing the Request, (a) token set -> header 'Authorization' equals 'Bearer <token>' (urllib normalizes the key to 'Authorization'); (b) token unset or blank -> no Authorization header; (c) the token string appears nowhere in the written output JSON for a run whose fake opener returns a 401 HTTPError.

FINISH: ruff format and ruff check both files; run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_boarding_probe.py`. Report any existing test changed.
